title.narrative: Anyim Maber (bright and better future): Enhanced opportunities for employment and employability for youth with disabilities

description.narrative: Contract related to: Anyim Maber (bright and better future): Enhanced opportunities for employment and employability for youth with disabilities - The proposed Action intents to contribute to Specific-Objective 1.3: Support CSOs as actors of good governance and development in partner countries and to the achievement of the related result 1.3: Civil Society Organisations¿ (CSOs) ability to engage as actors of good governance and development at country level is improved.The Action rolls out the EU support to country-level CSO initiatives aimed at implementing priorities reflected in the NDICI-GLOBAL Europe, Annex III CSO Thematic Programme and the subsequent draft Multiannual Indicative Plan for the same. In line with the policy of geographisation, a majority of funds under the CSO MAAP 2021-2024, will be allocated under the Action to support civil society in partner countries in Africa, Asia and the Pacific, Latin America and Caribbean, and in Neighbourhood countries and Russia. Activities funded under the Action will support a broad range of civil society actors including and prioritising, but not limited to, women and youth organisations, In the framework of the Country Roadmaps for EU and Member States engagement with civil society (CSO Roadmaps), all initiatives under the Action will aim at and contribute to strengthening civil society partner¿s institutional and operational capacity through a comprehensive approach; enabling and ensuring their participation; and on improving the environment in which they operate. Particular attention will be paid to CSOs capacities to benefit from the digital transformation which will pay attention to accessible digital technology and reduce the gap on access to ICT.

title.narrative: Linkage to extension services

description.narrative: OPDs play an active role in raising awareness and engaging key stakeholders on inclusive employment interventions

title.narrative: Number of youths with disabilities linked to extension services by OPDs

description.narrative: Organizations of People with Disabilities will identify available extension services within their districts and refer youth entrepreneurs with disabilities, after upskilling from Challenges Uganda to subcounty/parish level extension services relevant to their industry. Extension workers will provide technical guidance to their respective industries e.g., agriculture, manufacturing, commercial, to youth business owners. OPDs will hold information sessions between youth with disabilities and extension workers and through this interaction, both the youth and the extension workers will understand what is available and create linkages for further referral and support.

title.narrative: Overall project impact statement

description.narrative: Socioeconomic empowerment of female and male youth with disabilities in Oyam, Nwoya, Gulu and Amuru by October 2026.

title.narrative: Percentage labour force participation rate among young people with disabilities

description.narrative: Labour force participation is defined as those in (1) paid employment, (2) selfemployment, (3) actively seeking paid employment or (4) actively seeking self employment Paid employment receive a wage or payment in kind Selfemployed own account worker, member of a cooperative, employer Actively seeking employment actively looked for work in the last four weeks. Actively looked for work will be selfdefined. Actively seeking self employment within the last four weeks, selfdefinedProject participants means the jobseekers who will be people with disabilities that projects support to gain skills and enter employment (paid or self) or improve their employment situationLabour force participation rate is the proportion of project participants that fit the categories as above

comment.narrative: 20 rolling basis as cohorts are registered
Current baseline is 20 which is to be affirmed as cohorts are being registered.

title.narrative: VTIs are inclusive of youth with disabilities

description.narrative: VTIs or TVET institutions are inclusive of youth with disabilities and generate the skills demanded in the local market

title.narrative: Number of VTI staff trained on disability inclusion

description.narrative: The indicator counts staff from the VTI trained on disability inclusion aimed at building disability confidence of VTI staff. It also address barriers to the inclusion of youth with disability in technical and vocational skills development programmes. This included refresher training of staff from Daniel Comboni Vocational Institute and Gulu Vocational Institute who were previously trained under Inclusion works.

description.narrative: Youth wings of OPDs are established or strengthened in intervention districts and have the capacity to participate in and influence the preparation of Parish Action plans and budgets and appropriate levels of disability disaggregation of data in the parishbased management information system.

title.narrative: Influencing Domain

description.narrative: Youth with disabilities meaningfully contribute to governance processes to raise awareness of the barriers they face and to promote a conducive business environment to operate their enterprises and secure decent employment

title.narrative: Percentage of PDM plans that are developed with participation of Youth wing Members

description.narrative: The Parish Development Model is premised on the model that the Parish Development Committee(PDC) together with common citizens as the end user of social services are better placed to identify and respond to their own needs, priorities, and direct use of resources. PDM aims to To deepen the decentralisation process; improve household incomes; enable inclusive, sustainable, balanced and equitable socioeconomic transformation; and increase accountability at local levels.The Model positions the PARISH as the epicenter of multisectoral community development, planning, implementation, supervision and accountability. Parish as the lowest reference unit for planning, budgeting and delivery of interventions to drive socioeconomic transformation.The indicator will report on the proportion of parish action plans and budgets that the yuth wing members were nvolved to develop
